question: Does Gandi offer a free-standing DNS zone or secondary DNS service for a domain registered elsewhere, and is the generic LiveDNS nameservers route truly unauthenticated?
why: The docs call https://api.gandi.net/v5/livedns/nameservers/{fqdn} unauthenticated, but a read-only probe returned HTTP 401. The product pages only document free DNS for domains registered at Gandi; a free zone for external domains is unverified.
